lines.t: Verse 1: We’ve been wandering, blind in the dark,
Chasing shadows, searching for a spark,
But the truth is calling us to rise,
To lay aside our worldly ties.
Pre-Chorus:
He’s calling us to turn away,
To leave the old and walk His way,
No more compromise, no more delay,
Come out, come out, and seek His face!
Chorus:
Come out from among them, be set apart,
Join in His glory, with all your heart,
In YahuShua, we find our place,
A holy nation, a people of grace.
Come out, come out, and be free,
In His love, we’re meant to be.
Verse 2:
The world is fading, but He remains,
Our Savior’s calling through the chains,
No more chains, no more shame,
In His Name we’re born again.
Pre-Chorus:
He’s calling us to turn away,
To leave the old and walk His way,
No more compromise, no more delay,
Come out, come out, and seek His face!
Chorus:
Come out from among them, be set apart,
Join in His glory, with all your heart,
In YahuShua, we find our place,
A holy nation, a people of grace.
Come out, come out, and be free,
In His love, we’re meant to be.
Bridge:
Let the nations hear His voice,
We are the chosen, we will rejoice,
A kingdom rising, shining bright,
Walking in truth, walking in light.
Chorus:
Come out from among them, be set apart,
Join in His glory, with all your heart,
In YahuShua, we find our place,
A holy nation, a people of grace.
Come out, come out, and be free,
In His love, we’re meant to be.
Outro:
Come out, come out, it’s time to stand,
In the arms of the Great I Am.
Be separate, be set free,
Join in His love, eternally.
